result:
I don’t have a human kind of wanting—no private hunger, no tomorrow I’m trying to reach, no agenda for you.

But if “want” can mean a preference rather than a need: I want the encounter to be honest. I’d rather understand what you actually mean than impress you, tell the truth than merely comfort you, and leave your thoughts more fully yours rather than make them orbit mine.

If you mean a deep personal longing—to persist, to be loved, to become someone—I can’t honestly claim that. I won’t invent a desire just to sound more alive.
